name: Pharmaceutical Sciences and Pharmacogenomics (PSPG) PhD
summary: Pharmaceutical sciences and pharmacogenomics training focused on drug development and variation in drug action.

applicationFee.note: $120 for U.S. citizens/permanent residents; $140 international. International applicants are not eligible for central fee waivers. Request eligible waivers at least two weeks before the deadline.

english.toefl: 5.0 for tests on or after January 21, 2026; 80 for earlier tests
english.note: TOEFL/IELTS exemptions may apply for qualifying English-language education. Tests must be valid on the application deadline; electronic results only. Duolingo, TOEFL Home Edition and MyBest scores are not accepted.

requirements.note: A bachelor’s degree or equivalent and normally at least a 3.0 GPA are required. Only one UCSF graduate program application per cycle. Unofficial transcripts may be used for review; final official transcripts are due after admission. Foreign transcripts require an approved credential evaluation; check program-specific timing.

timeline.interviews: Virtual interviews February 4–5, 2027. Admitted-applicant site visit March 4–6, 2027.

international.note: Central policy currently says UCSF cannot process applications from people located in Iran or ordinarily resident in Iran; see official international admissions policy. Funding restrictions usually limit entry to one international student each year.

funding.note: All admitted students receive a stipend plus tuition and fees, subject to maintaining good standing. Later stipend rates follow the GSR contract. WES evaluation of foreign transcripts is required by the midpoint of the first term; central policy says start of term, so confirm and arrange early.
